title: sunipia candida
intro: Sunipia candida, commonly known as Chinese Thunder of Heaven, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, reducing inflammation, and improving cardiovascular health.
